title: hummbl-lattice: Domain-Specific Reasoning Operator Lattices — Validation, Rating, and Cohort Tooling
description: Python library for building, validating, and rating Domain120 lattices — domain-specific reasoning operator sets that generalize TRIZ's 40-principle structure across arbitrary domains of practice. Provides lattice data models, a validator with 6 ratification checks, a Fleiss' kappa calculator for inter-rater reliability (Severe Test 2), and CLI tooling. Stdlib-only, zero third-party dependencies. Part of the HUMMBL governance infrastructure program.
